title: JWT Storage: HttpOnly Cookies vs localStorage
description: Compare secure JWT storage strategies for React apps.

data.text:
**JWT Storage Options**

Choosing where to store JWTs in a React app has significant security implications.

data.title: localStorage vs HttpOnly Cookie

data.text: For production React apps, prefer HttpOnly cookies with SameSite=Strict and CSRF protection. Use localStorage only for non-sensitive data or when you need to share tokens across subdomains.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: HttpOnly cookies: safer, need CSRF protection
data.takeaway: HttpOnly cookies are generally safer for storing JWTs in React apps.
